records.label: Child mortality reduction in India
records.value: 37 per cent reduction in child mortality between 2014 and 2022
records.subject: India

records.label: Impact of improved sanitation and hygiene on child health
records.value: Improved access to clean water and sanitation reduced incidence of diarrhoeal disease, malnutrition and infection – some of the leading causes of death in young children
records.subject: India

records.label: Government-led WASH program backing
records.value: Ambitious government-led movement backed by UNICEF and enabled by sustained investments of unrestricted funding
records.subject: Government of India

records.label: Swachh Bharat Mission launch
records.value: Government of India launched the Swachh Bharat (Clean India) Mission, one of the largest sanitation programmes in the world in 2014
records.subject: Government of India

records.label: Swachh Bharat Mission goal
records.value: Provide universal access to sanitation and eliminate open defecation by constructing over 110 million toilets for 550 million people across the country
records.subject: Government of India

records.label: Swachh Bharat Mission target achievement date
records.value: Ambitious target was achieved by 2019
records.subject: Government of India

records.label: People reached with basic sanitation in last 10 years
records.value: 550 million people have been reached with at least basic sanitation
records.subject: India

records.label: People reached with improved drinking water in last 10 years
records.value: 580 million people with improved drinking water in their homes
records.subject: India

records.label: Swachh Bharat nationwide coverage
records.value: By 2024, Swachh Bharat had reached nearly every corner of the country
records.subject: India

records.label: WASH system transformation focus
records.value: Catalysed a shift in mindset – from building toilets to strengthening systems for sustainable sanitation services, including solid and liquid waste management and climate-responsive initiatives
records.subject: India

records.label: UNICEF partner role in Swachh Bharat
records.value: UNICEF has been a trusted partner in the mission's design, delivery and scaling up, helping ensure that infrastructure was matched with systems-strengthening, community engagement and behaviour change
records.subject: UNICEF

records.label: UNICEF technical support delivery
records.value: UNICEF supported this shift by embedding technical advisors in every state, and building the capacity of local governments to improve and monitor services over time
records.subject: UNICEF

records.label: Jal Jeevan Mission launch
records.value: India launched the Jal Jeevan (Water is Life) Mission to achieve universal access to safe and adequate drinking water
records.subject: Government of India

records.label: Rural households with piped water connections in last 5 years
records.value: More than 115 million rural households have gained piped water connections in their homes for the first time over the last five years
records.subject: India

records.label: Core Resources importance to WASH program
records.value: Unrestricted Core Resources have been critical to this success
records.subject: UNICEF

records.label: Core Resources flexibility benefit
records.value: While other resources can be fragmented or time-bound, Core Resources allowed UNICEF to be a consistent, strategic partner, year after year – playing a central role in planning, monitoring and scaling up the programme
records.subject: UNICEF

records.label: WASH data management improvement by UNICEF
records.value: UNICEF worked closely with government to strengthen WASH data systems, enabling more accurate, timely and actionable data to guide decisions and track progress at every level
records.subject: UNICEF

records.label: Household savings from toilet construction
records.value: Every family living in the village who are constructing toilets in their homes is saving at least 50,000 rupees ($650)

records.label: Groundwater quality improvement
